doctor_backend.gpu: one pinned server per physical GPU 0..4 (five_gpu.doctor_urls)

feedback.leakage_guard: No ground truth or outcome label in Doctor input; validate original Agent reply IDs; structured none-supported experience allowed

verification.short_circuit: decide at two agreeing reruns (2 of K=3)
verification.support_order: uniform random without replacement, deterministic per run seed + case ID + rubric ID; sample at most 5 same-ID trajectories
verification.target: member feedback behavioral locus (target_reply_id); Stage-1 Applicable required, No Match -> next sampled trajectory
verification.keep: KEEP at the first sampled trajectory with at least 2/3 target outcomes; NOT_VALIDATED and excluded from scoring if all 5 sampled trajectories are exhausted without a witness

notes.rounds: maximum Agent turns per branch (G = rollout.branching children per decision point); also used by the Agent prompt and intervention reruns
notes.budget: full_tree only; pruning / subsampling is not defined
notes.rubric: One rubric per trajectory or conservative same-reason reuse, separately within case and outcome stratum. Success: observed helpful behavior=2; level 0 removes only that behavior. Failure: observed problem/omission=0; level 2 corrects that same problem. Level 1 is explicitly partial.
notes.rubric.gold_answer_visible: Doctor feedback and the Rubric Generator never receive a gold field (the final decision plus the outcome can imply it)
notes.post_hoc_gates: blocking: schema, deterministic leakage / answer copy, Jev answer_presupposition, Jev new_domain_premise; recorded only: observable
notes.intervention: Score 0 and 2 use the same pinned Agent role, information boundary and five-sentence limit. The selected level template and saved instruction enter the system message; the user supplies only visible question, options and prefix. Doctor and scorer receive no intervention instruction.
notes.reruns_per_intervention: K = continuations per intervention target; a rerun count, not a rubric count
notes.R_O: Target flips / K: Score-2 counts parsed success (1), Score-0 counts parsed failure (0). Unparsed FINAL (None) stays in the denominator but never counts as a flip (parsed_target_only_v1).
notes.selection: unused for training under bounded_witness_v1 (min_R_O applies only to the exhaustive protocol); prompt-search J is unchanged
notes.scoring: kept rubrics score every response node of the tree with the two-stage scorer; No Match records are kept without a score
notes.agent_reward: frozen 2026-10-07: outcome_only 1.0 / 0.0 (arm override), outcome + rubric arms 0.5 / 0.5; a rubric-only condition would be 0.0 / 1.0. Per node: w_outcome * mean(descendant outcomes) + w_rubric * R_A | r_a_weighting = equal: R_A = unweighted mean of level/2 over the applicable KEEP rubrics; verification is a gate only (R_O(R) is no longer a weight).
notes.prompt_update: Disabled: P0 is fixed for the complete run; no P1 generation, prompt comparison or prompt refinement.
notes.prompt_hashes: scripts/online_rl/run_tree.py refuses to launch when a prompt/template file differs from its sha256
notes.evaluation: At each 30-case checkpoint, pause rollout and update; evaluate the frozen checkpoint on all 622 cases using the shared GPU0-4 actor pool, then resume training.
notes.data: 500 unique MedMCQA train cases (all subjects), random.Random(20261006).sample without replacement over source-order unique, non-protected train rows (manifest train_random500_seed20261006.manifest.json, source parquet sha b119434b...); gold = options[ABCD[cop]] (cop is 0-based in the source); not redistributed
notes.schedule: 120 same ordered cases, five per batch on GPU0-4; GPU4 updates after batch; checkpoint every30 cases; no evaluation.
notes.arms: scripts/online_rl/run_tree.py --condition {outcome_only, fixed, evolving} (src/online_rl/tree/conditions.py); outcome_only = rubric.enabled false (reward = outcome component only, no feedback / rubric / verification / scoring / prompt events), fixed = prompt_update.enabled false, evolving = both on; output_dir/<arm>
notes.feedback: Same local Doctor after FINAL, all-reflection-claims generator audit retained. Missing evidence does not become an earlier request.
notes.model_roles: Prompt reflection/diagnosis and prompt refinement both use pinned Claude Sonnet 5.5 (anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5-20260928); both receive the same evidence bundle. Other roles retain their configured models.
notes.luna_alignment: strict JSON-schema output; trivial canonicalisation; at most one repair request to the same Luna model with the same input; a second invalid output is an operational error (retried on resume), never mapped or filled in
notes.rubric_reuse: same-reason REUSE vs NEW per case and outcome stratum (src/online_rl/tree/rubric_bank.py): one MATCH-vs-NEW decision per later trajectory, a new rubric only for a new reason; every member verified on its own path; KEEP iff max_j s_j >= min_R_O; R_O(R) = max_j s_j; each kept rubric scored once
notes.rubric.generation: Gemini 3.8 Flash reasons mandatorily; effort low + 4096 tokens + strict JSON schema fixes the Stage-A truncation (16/32 cut off at 1200)
notes.doctor_backend: Local Ollama Doctor protocol v2; min 2 Agent turns, maximum 5, seeded calls.
notes.verification: For each shared rubric, test at most five sampled same-ID trajectories. Each member has its own stored turn and instruction. Fresh Agent reply then one Doctor FINAL per rerun, with within-member 2-of-3 early decision.
notes.output_root: 2026-10-07: final 100+100 runs on 165.132.141.140 (convei-rack2-140, 8x RTX A6000) from case 1; outputs/sherpa_tree_v1_d1frozen (RTX 4090, stopped after Outcome-only case 1) is an aborted diagnostic: Agent tokens are hardware-dependent, so hardware is not mixed within a run
notes.doctor_opening: New five-GPU protocol: immutable runtime D1 per case/protocol, shared across saved checkpoints; no frozen VAL50 table dependency.
notes.agent_protocol: frozen 2026-10-07: independent pre-assessment followed by collaborator-conditioned response (src/online_rl/agent_protocol.py); Stage A blind to the dialogue, Stage B sees its own Stage-A assessment as hidden context; joint two-stage GRPO action; shared by every reward arm; Agent prompt prompts/agent.txt and decoding unchanged
notes.feedback_locus: behavior_observer_v5 links physician request/objection -> the Agent reply -> observed later response or unresolved need; maintained stance may still be useful. It describes sequence, not causality, and returns target_reply_id.
notes.prompt_search_J: One common P0/P1 comparison per five-case batch on identical frozen trees. Each side reuses the same random-10 witness protocol; prompt fitness uses tested trajectories only and compares their paired intersection. For each tested trajectory, sampled target hits / executed reruns is its effect score; invalid/no-match count as zero and unexamined members are omitted. Compute source-success and source-failure means separately, then multiply. Training KEEP and prompt fitness are distinct uses of shared witness results.
notes.rubric_source_consistency: The Rubric Generator receives feedback target_reply_id and its pre-reply dialogue. The new rubric must match both visible contexts at that locus; one repair may change applicability contexts only. Existing user_side_context / agent_side_state / behavior shape and [Assign or create] six-check reuse contract are preserved.
notes.batch: Five cases per batch on GPU0..4. Ready Agent/Doctor/FINAL/rerun/teacher jobs share all five frozen actors. Agent4 / Doctor1. After all five cases complete, GPU4 updates once; every actor reloads before the next phase. Checkpoints every six batches (30 cases), plus initial0 and final500.
notes.doctor_final: FINAL outputs only Final answer: option <label>, no explanation or answer text, max32 tokens; discussion/hidden STATUS retain their existing budget and schema.
notes.prompt_update_evidence: Diagnostic reflection and refiner both receive the same bounded evidence JSON; refiner cache key includes evidence hash. First P1 uses P0 evidence only; revise from paired P0/P1 comparison only after evaluation.
notes.prompt_update_schema_guard: accepts legacy applicability_condition or observed-context applicability with user_side_context and agent_side_state
notes.prompt_update_reuse_guard: allows reuse-section edits only for reuse-focused directions while preserving all six checks and JSON decision contract
notes.prompt_update.refiner_guard: No arbitrary word cap; 6000-token refiner output; observed-context schema (user_side_context + agent_side_state in applicability and all score levels) is mandatory.
notes.rubric_generation: Pinned pilot_joint_v2_1 joint generator with local schema validation. The generator selects the source turn from actual transcript IDs; feedback remains reference evidence. Failed source applicability rejects the joint candidate rather than separately repairing its condition.
notes.scorer: Explicit response_evidence_v1 scorer with independently validated literal evidence for each response. Four sibling responses per request. UNSCORABLE is distinct from zero, nonapplicability and operational failure.
notes.grpo_sampling: Use raw policy sampling (temperature 1, top_p 1, top_k 0) so sampled actions and stored raw policy log probabilities match the GRPO importance-ratio distribution. This guard is specific to this new training configuration.
notes.run: User requested same 120 problems, fixed P0 with reflection audit, now maximum two Agent turns. Fresh seeded base+LoRA initialization; no max4 rollout, reflection, rubric, rerun or scoring cache imported.
notes.rollout_reuse: Disabled: maximum Agent turns changed. Recompute the complete protocol identity; prior max4 frozen override is null.
notes.gate: Evidence gate v2 with v2.1 prompt separates explicit task-selection instructions from a prescribed clinical answer. Other quality checks, blind original behavior scoring and witness KEEP are retained.
notes.gate_activation: A separate output directory is required. Do not reuse legacy gate decisions, verified banks or final scores as v2 evidence. This config does not modify a running process. Validate any cache-only transition before launch and retain its source-policy and protocol provenance.
notes.feedback_grounding: Generator preserves each original helpful/unresolved reflection claim and records accepted/rejected parts plus exact speaker/turn evidence. Retrospective-only needs cannot become earlier omission/applicability. Local validation checks coverage, attribution and chronology; it does not certify semantic entailment.
notes.activation: Fresh isolated max2 experiment; previous max4 run and its incomplete batch remain preserved.
notes.gate_quotes: Literal rubric quotation fields select an exact full visible field through the per-call schema enum. Quality checks, independent source score and exact evidence validation remain mandatory. Malformed output is an operational error, never a negative rubric or zero reward.

execution.note: execution only (thread counts); values and cache keys are unchanged. Doctor worker endpoints come from SHERPA_DOCTOR_ENDPOINTS (provenance in the manifest)
